fin: Which one will you try first?

scenes.voix: Stop reaching for the mouse in VS Code. These three shortcuts cover things you probably do dozens of times every single day.
Number one: Control D. It selects the next match of the word under your cursor, so you can rename several variables at once.
Number two: Alt and click. It drops an extra cursor wherever you want, and you type in several places at the same time.
Number three: Control P. Type a few letters of a file name and it opens right away, without digging through the folder tree. Try all three today.
